Legal.title: Legal notice & confidentiality
Legal.identity_text: This site is published by Badr Eddine ELBOUAMRI, in a personal capacity, as part of a job search. Contact: badrbouamri4@gmail.com.
Legal.anonymisation_text: Case studies drawn from internships (Stellantis, AIC Métallurgie, Nexteer Automotive) are deliberately indexed or anonymised: no absolute cost, production volume, supplier name, real part reference, or screenshot of an internal document is published. Only relative or indexed results, redrawn schematics, and synthetic data are presented.
Legal.analytics_text: This site does not use advertising-tracking cookies. A privacy-friendly, cookieless audience measurement tool (Vercel Web Analytics) is planned to understand site traffic.
Legal.contact_data_text: Information submitted through the contact form (name, email, organisation, message) is used only to respond to your message. It is never resold, shared with a third party, or used for commercial purposes.
Legal.rights_text: For any question or request to delete your data, contact me directly by email.
